facts.fact: CRT identifies the Chouara tanneries near the Fez watercourse and describes leather processing and craftsmen’s work. It recommends observing from nearby terraces rather than establishing a visitor walkway among the vats.
facts.excerpt: Les tanneries Chouara … Des terrasses avoisinantes vous pouvez admirer le travail acharné des artisans peaussiers.

facts.fact: The article mentions leather becoming bags, coats and shoes. It does not establish a universal public terrace, a free visit, an opening timetable or passenger access to industrial areas.
facts.location: Final sentence and absence of an admission/schedule block; access cautions are editorial planning advice.

notes: Terrace ownership and access conditions are not inferred from a tourist recommendation. The manuscript advises asking each operator about permission, charges and shop arrangements before entering; no shop, price or compulsory purchase is invented.
